description:
## Why This Exists

post/injection.rs defines its own find_header_end(), find_line_end(), skip_line_terminator() functions. These overlap with post/mod.rs::find_header_boundary() and split_header_body(). The duplication means bug fixes must be applied in multiple places.

## Acceptance Criteria

Consolidate the line-scanning helpers into post/mod.rs (or a post::util submodule) and import them from injection.rs.
title: Readability: injection.rs find_header_end / find_line_end / skip_line_terminator duplicate logic from post/mod.rs
